newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Milwaukee, Wis.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Milwaukee County, Wisconsin
$14,735,000* General Obligation Refunding Airport Bonds,
Series 1997A
(Subject to Alternative Minimum Tax) and
$2,500,000 General Obligation Building Bonds, Series 1997A
(Collectively the Bonds'')
Bids for the Bonds will be received by the Director, Department of Administration on
Thursday, July 17, 1997
until 10:00 a.m., Central Time, in Room 308, Milwaukee
County Courthouse, Milwaukee, Wisconsin 53233. The Bonds will be dated September 1, 1997, as the date of
original issue, and will bear interest payable on April 1
and October 1 of each year, commencing April 1, 1998. The
Bonds will mature on October 1 in the amounts and years as
follows:
General Obligation Refunding Airport Bonds, Series 1997A
(AMT)
Year Amount Year Amount
General Obligation Building Bonds, Series 1997A
Year Amount Year Amount
The County may elect to prepay on October 1, 2006, and on
any day thereafter, Bonds due on or after October 1, 2007.
Redemption may be in whole or in part of the Bonds subject
to prepayment. All prepayments shall be at a price of par
plus accrued interest to the date of redemption.
The Bonds will be general obligations of the County for
which the County will pledge its full faith and credit and
power to levy direct general ad valorem taxes.
A bid for not less than $14,631,855 and accrued interest
on the total principal amount of the General Obligation
Refunding Airport Bonds shall be filed with the undersigned
prior to the time set for the opening of bids. A bid for not
less than $2,475,000 and accrued interest on the total
principal amount of the General Obligation Building Bonds
shall be filed with the undersigned prior to the time set
for the opening of bids.
A copy of the County's Preliminary Official Statem
dated July 1, 1997, may be obtained by contacting Evensen
Dodge, Inc., 601 Second Avenue South, Suite 5100,
Minneapolis, Minnesota 55402, (612/338-3535) or Ronald
Gindt, Capital Finance Manager, Department of
Administration, 901 North Ninth Street, Room 308, Milwaukee,
/s/ Earl R. Hawkins, Jr.
Director, Department of Administration
*Preliminary, subject to change
(From The Bond Buyer)
